title: Set 181

sentences.ko: 응, 귀 때문에 드디어 병원 갔어. 알고 보니 그냥 귀지였는데, 2분 만에 씻어 내는 거 하려고 대기실에서 한 시간이나 앉아 있었어.
sentences.text: Yeah, I finally went in about my ear. Turns out it was just wax, and I sat in the waiting room for an hour just so they could rinse it out in like two minutes.

alts.text: So I finally got my ear checked. It was just wax! Sat there an hour for them to flush it out in, like, two minutes.
I finally had my ear examined. It turned out to be only wax, and I sat in the waiting room for an hour only for them to rinse it out in about two minutes.

sentences.note: **turns out** 는 알고 보니 ~였다는 뜻으로, 예상과 다른 결과를 말할 때 써요. **rinse it out** 은 물로 씻어 낸다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, 위층 사는 데이나예요. 식기세척기 물이 또 안 빠져요. 이 일로 자꾸 귀찮게 해 드리기 싫어서 그러는데, 이번에는 또 사람 불러서 땜질하지 말고 그냥 새걸로 바꿔 주실 수 있을까요?
sentences.text: Hi, it's Dana from upstairs. The dishwasher stopped draining again, and I don't want to keep bugging you about it, so is there any chance you could just replace it this time instead of having someone patch it up again?

alts.text: Hey, Dana upstairs here. Dishwasher's not draining again, and I hate to keep bugging you, but could you maybe just replace it this time instead of getting it patched up again?

Hello, this is Dana from the apartment upstairs. The dishwasher has stopped draining once again, and I do not wish to keep troubling you about it. Would it be possible to replace it this time rather than having someone repair it again?

sentences.note: **keep bugging you** 는 자꾸 귀찮게 한다는 뜻이에요. **patch it up** 은 임시로 고쳐 놓는다는 말이고, **is there any chance you could** 는 부탁을 부드럽게 꺼낼 때 써요.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 네가 말해 준 그 태국 음식점 드디어 가 봤어. 음식은 진짜 맛있었는데 자리 나길 40분이나 기다려서, 금요일 저녁에 또 갈지는 모르겠어.
sentences.text: We finally tried that Thai place you told us about. The food was really good, but we waited forty minutes for a table, so I don't know if I'd go back on a Friday night.

alts.text: We finally hit up that Thai place you told us about. Food was great, but we waited forty minutes for a table, so I dunno about going back on a Friday night.
We finally visited the Thai restaurant you recommended. The food was excellent, but we waited forty minutes for a table, so I am not certain I would return on a Friday evening.

sentences.note: **you told us about** 는 네가 우리한테 말해 준이라는 뜻으로, 가게나 물건 뒤에 붙여요. **go back** 은 다시 간다는 뜻이고, **hit up** 은 어떤 가게에 가 본다는 캐주얼한 표현이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 나 디저트 먹고 일어나 봐야 돼. 베이비시터한테 10시까지 집에 간다고 했거든. 또 늦으면 이제 돈을 두 배로 받기 시작할 거야.
sentences.text: I'm going to have to head out after dessert, because I told the babysitter we'd be home by ten, and if I'm late again she's going to start charging me double.

alts.text: I gotta take off after dessert. Told the babysitter we'd be back by ten, and if I'm late again she's gonna start charging me double.
I will need to leave after dessert, as I told the babysitter we would be home by ten, and if I am late again, she will begin charging me double.

sentences.note: **head out** 은 자리를 뜬다, 나간다는 뜻이에요. 캐주얼한 **take off** 도 같은 뜻이고, **charging me double** 은 나한테 두 배로 받는다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 그만둘까 계속 생각하는데, 말 꺼내려고 할 때마다 상사가 나한테 엄청 잘해 줘서, 미안한 마음에 얘기를 못 꺼내겠어.
sentences.text: I keep thinking about quitting, but every time I'm about to say something, my boss does something really nice for me, and then I feel too guilty to bring it up.

alts.text: Kinda wanna quit, but whenever I'm about to say it, my boss does something super nice and I feel way too guilty to bring it up.
I continue to consider resigning, but each time I am about to raise the matter, my manager does something very kind for me, and I then feel too guilty to mention it.

sentences.note: **bring it up** 은 어떤 이야기를 꺼낸다는 뜻이에요. **too guilty to** 는 너무 미안해서 ~를 못 한다는 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 1번 한국어 '2분 정도면 씻어 내는 걸 하려고'가 어색해서 '2분 만에 씻어 내는 거 하려고'로 고침
1번 formal 이 대기실에서 한 시간을 기다린 것을 그 목적처럼 적어 억울한 느낌이 사라졌기에 'only for them to'로 바꾸고, waited an hour in the waiting room 중복도 정리함
3번 note 의 the place you told us about 는 문장에 그대로 나오지 않아(that Thai place you told us about) you told us about 로 고침
4번 한국어 '받겠대'는 베이비시터가 직접 한 말처럼 읽히는데, 영어는 내 짐작(she's going to start)이라 '받기 시작할 거야'로 고침
5번 casual 의 I keep thinking I'll quit 은 '그만둘 것 같다'는 예상으로 읽혀 뜻이 달라지므로 Kinda wanna quit 으로 바꿈
5번 한국어 '사장님'은 boss 를 너무 좁게 옮긴 것이라 '상사'로 고침
